baseline_manifest.corpus_scope: Original full FinRank first-occurrence exact-text corpus: positives and hard negatives from ALL records
baseline_manifest.dense: SentenceTransformer default max_seq_length; normalized vectors and cosine
baseline_manifest.metrics: Original per_record_metrics; macro averages multiplied by 100; same np.argsort tie behavior
baseline_manifest.note: Quantitative includes direct lookup, calculations and interpretation. No training or gold-answer generation.

note: Positive control: official issuer-held-out quantitative test queries; identical 5,230 corpus and top20 reranking for original, enriched and trained models. No test metric used for checkpoint/rate selection. Not a ceiling or proof that every weak-label source would succeed/fail.
